selection: test split; pandas sample(n=1, random_state=42) per class
comparison: Shared upstream; original_off uses fixed terminal BUE then CBT; on uses only BUE/CBT in MCTS and disables terminal BUE/CBT.
action_geometry: Original operators, projected onto the unchanged seed-relative +/-25% endpoint limits; no extra scales or shift actions.
interpretation: System variant comparison, not an isolated attribution to MCTS: operator placement changes too. skip_only is an auxiliary control.
priors: Existing frozen category caps; no tuning on selected labels. Provenance of older GT-derived caps is not independently established.
evidence: Existing v217 coverage settings (32 images, boundary gap 1.5s, evidence gap 3s); strict acceptance; all_valid trigger.
cost: Result token_usage and processing_time cover the entire paired run, not an individual arm.
limitations: One test video per class is a smoke/pilot comparison, not a full benchmark or significance test.
